page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.mn4.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.mn4 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, utilizing a shared CPU allocation model. It includes 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers of compute and memory capabilities. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 1090.78, while multi-core performance reached 2067.18. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 158.75 GB/sec, dropping to 16.93 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Geekbench testing yielded a single-core score of 939.0 and a multi-core score of 1598.0. Database operations under Redis achieved 2.58 million SET operations per second, and static web serving throughput was recorded at 2.32 GB/sec.

Given the shared CPU allocation and lower benchmark scores, the ecs.mn4.large is positioned as a budget-friendly option for non-critical, low-intensity workloads. The lack of local storage and baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps limits its utility for high-throughput data processing or heavy database workloads. It is best suited for lightweight applications, basic web serving, development environments, and small-scale testing where resource demands are predictable and low.
